items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: you always looked forward in doing some of Chu's records, because the sidemen that he would pick, you loved to play with.

ctx.x: I guess we've kind of eased into Cab's band without trying to. Before we do that let me take it back a step to the small group records that you made, with Chu. Let's see, I'll just read off the names of the guys who were on there. Maybe that might jiggle a few memories for you. It was Chu, Hot Lips Paige, George Matthews on Trombone, Buster Bailey, Horace Henderson, Lawrence Lucie, Israel Crosby and you, and that was in 1937. You did 'Now You're Talking My Language,' 'Indiana,' 'Too Marvelous for Words,' and…

Yeah I remember them, they were all good sessions. It wasn't anything outstanding about them, but as a whole they were all good sessions, you know, and you always looked forward in doing some of Chu's records, because the sidemen that he would pick, you loved to play with.
Yeah, a band like that I'm sure.
